innerBorder.policy: Shared white-band geometry from the prior frozen fit; independent robust RGB offset from 34 white cards. No outer-stock, frame, illustration, text, or scan-transform adjustment.

textHistory.meaning: One-pixel local-contrast edge F1. Individual fits describe attainable per-card alignment, not released defaults. Whole-card scores retain the v0.2.23 weights, coverage and accepted scan poses; unverified credits are excluded from that aggregate. Shared values are trained on separate name/artist cohorts. A percentage is an overlap index, not a percentage of correctness.
textHistory.currentFinding: The archived per-card fits and shared Alpha models are not consumed by the current renderer. Its legacy centering/margin policy and 0.5.1 ink correction remain active. The local frame experiment initially copied original bodies but 21 modern type-line fallbacks. Native replay of the archived shared layout candidate is separate from fitting the new frame/border and keeps current unthinned ink.

notes: All original rules bodies were unchanged; 21 original type lines were corrected after checking all 45 scans.
Frozen affine scan poses, frame/paper texture and HSB fit are unchanged. The initial fit excluded dark stock.
Inner-border geometry and its additive RGB offset are independent of white material, art and outer stock.
The complete/shared-text pair uses artwork from the same scan. Art matching is extraction fidelity, not independent prediction.
The text comparison replays the previously unadopted shared Alpha model using current ink and explicit overflow fallback. It is not a new fit or a new independent validation.
All scores are indices out of 100. No set completion or production score upload follows from this experiment.
